CustomField.description: Business-agnostic calendar days until the Active Due Date. 999 when there is no active review. Drives the due-status icon on the record page.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(Active_Due_Date__c), ISPICKVAL(Color_Review_Stage__c, "Complete"), ISPICKVAL(Color_Review_Stage__c, "Not Started"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Color_Review_Stage__c))), 999, Active_Due_Date__c - TODAY())
CustomField.label: Days To Active Due
